raw.details:
NEURA KNOCKOUT 2026

About the Competition

CodeNeuraX presents NEURA KNOCKOUT 2026, in collaboration with the Department of AI, ML & DS, Marwadi University — an offline web development challenge designed to test participants' web development skills, creativity, problem-solving ability, technical implementation, and ability to build practical solutions.

The competition is open to college and university students across India. Each participant will be provided with a problem statement by the organizers via email at 12:00 AM (midnight) on 24 October 2026. Participants must develop their solution based on the problem statement provided to them.

The final round will be conducted offline at Marwadi University, where participants will have 7 hours to develop, test, refine, deploy, and present their final solution.

 

Competition Details

- Event: NEURA KNOCKOUT 2026

- Organizer: CodeNeuraX

- In Collaboration With: Department of AI, ML & DS, Marwadi University

- Final Round Date: 24 October 2026

- Mode: Offline

- Venue: Marwadi University

- Problem Statement Release: 12:00 AM (midnight), 24 October 2026

- Competition Time: 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM

- Duration: 7 Hours

- Participation: Individual

- Registration Fee: ₹99

 

Problem Statement

The problem statement will be prepared and provided by the organizers.

- The problem statement will be shared with participants via email at 12:00 AM (midnight) on 24 October 2026.

- Participants must develop their solution based on the problem statement provided by the organizers.

- Participants can review the problem statement after it is released and before reporting to the venue.

- The official 7-hour competition window will be used for development, testing, refinement, deployment, and presentation of the solution.

 

Competition Process

1. Participants register individually for NEURA KNOCKOUT 2026.

2. The organizers will share the problem statement via email at 12:00 AM (midnight) on 24 October 2026.

3. Participants review the provided problem statement.

4. Participants report to Marwadi University for the offline competition.

5. The official competition begins at 9:00 AM.

6. Participants receive 7 hours to develop, test, refine, deploy, and prepare their solution.

7. Participants may use permitted AI tools, AI agents, frameworks, libraries, documentation, and development resources.

8. Participants must complete and deploy their web-based solution within the competition duration.

9. Only the deployed and accessible version of the solution will be considered for assessment and evaluation.

10. Participants must present/demo their deployed solution within the allotted 7-hour window.

11. The evaluation panel will assess the solutions and presentations.

12. Winners will be selected based on the overall evaluation.

13. Results will be announced by the organizers after completion of the evaluation process.

 

Rules

- Participation is strictly individual. Team participation is not permitted.

- The problem statement will be shared via email at 12:00 AM (midnight) on 24 October 2026.

- Participants must develop their solution based on the problem statement provided by the organizers.

- Participants must complete, deploy, and present their solution within the allotted 7-hour competition window.

- Only the deployed version of the solution will be considered for assessment. Participants must ensure that their deployed website is accessible and functional at the time of evaluation.

- Participants are permitted to use AI tools, AI agents, coding assistants, libraries, frameworks, documentation, and other development tools.

- Participants must not submit plagiarized or copied work from another participant.

- Impersonation or submission of work belonging to another person is strictly prohibited.

- Participants must not intentionally disrupt the competition, venue infrastructure, network, systems, or other participants.

- Any form of cheating, unfair practice, or violation of competition instructions may result in disqualification.

- Participants may be asked to demonstrate or explain their implementation to the evaluation panel.

- Participants are responsible for ensuring that their submitted solution is functional and ready for evaluation.

- Participants must follow all instructions provided by the organizers and venue authorities.

- The decision of the organizing and evaluation committee regarding the results will be final.

- The organizers reserve the right to modify the competition procedure or schedule if required due to unforeseen circumstances.

Registration Fee

₹99

 

Prizes

First Prize: ₹2,100

Second Prize: ₹1,500

Third Prize: ₹1,100

Premium goodies may be provided to top performers, and certificates will be provided to all participants.
